title: -webkit-fill-available and stretch
body:
Extracting a comment from [interop discussions](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/interop-2022-viewport/issues/18)
Just as a placeholder for now.

`width`/`height`, `(min|max)-(width|height)` with the value `stretch`

* Firefox 
  * [Unprefix -moz-fit-content and -moz-available keywords](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1495868). This is a Webcompat Priority P2 for Mozilla, as it creates webcompat issues. 
  * [support -moz-fit-content, and -moz-available for height/min-height/max-height (block axis)](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=567039)
  * [[css-sizing][meta] implement CSS Intrinsic & Extrinsic Sizing Module Level 3](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1312587)
* Chromium
  * [Behavior of width:-webkit-fill-available](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=807708) Chromium
  * [[css-sizing] Unprefix fill/stretch-fit keyword when ready](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=611857)
* WebKit 
  * Nothing specific [but a list of related bugs](https://bugs.webkit.org/buglist.cgi?quicksearch=fill-available&list_id=8507743)
* CSS WG
  * [CSS Box Sizing Module Level 4: stretch old value](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-sizing-4/#valdef-width-stretch)


It's a mess. 

Two years ago I was wondering [if there was a counter for `-webkit-fill-available`](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1495868#c7) @foolip

_Originally posted by @karlcow in https://github.com/web-platform-tests/interop-2022-viewport/issues/18#issuecomment-1224091012_
